site.title: PeerPush
site.short_description: Product discovery for people and AI with structured listings and a builder community.
site.long_description: PeerPush lists products with tags and pricing. Compare plans at peerpush.com/pricing. Submit at peerpush.com/submit.

opportunities.title: Free submission queue
opportunities.approval_time_hint: Waits behind paid Standard Launch submissions
opportunities.description: Submit for free on PeerPush pricing and wait in line behind paid launches. You still add a website URL on the listing; PeerPush does not document dofollow vs nofollow for the free tier — verify rel on your public product page after publish.

steps.body: Review Standard Launch vs the free queue on PeerPush pricing.
steps.title: Open pricing

steps.body: Choose Submit for Free and complete the product form at PeerPush submit.
steps.title: Submit for free

steps.body: Free listings publish after paid queue volume clears; confirm your live listing URL when it goes live.
steps.title: Wait for publish

opportunities.title: Standard launch
opportunities.approval_time_hint: Usually within a few business days after publish
opportunities.description: Standard Launch ($39 one-time on PeerPush pricing) publishes instantly with a permanent listing link to your website. Product pages on PeerPush typically link to your site without nofollow on listing pages — confirm rel on your live peerpush.com/p/… URL.

steps.body: Compare Standard Launch with the free queue on PeerPush pricing before you checkout.

steps.body: Confirm copy, discovery tags, screenshots, and pricing. Complete checkout for Standard Launch to go live immediately.
